about: Every string on the Rally page. Use these exactly. {name} marks a value filled in at run time, written as shown in formats.

formats.about: How filled-in values look. Times are always the court's or city's local time.

time.rule: 12-hour, hours without a leading zero, always two-digit minutes, lowercase am/pm. Slot chips, local time and next open.

hour.rule: 12-hour, hour only, lowercase am/pm. Opening hours.

date.rule: Day without a leading zero, then the three-letter month. The date someone joined the waitlist.

weekday.rule: The full weekday name. Next open on a later day, and closures.

items.q: How do you know if a court is playable?
items.a: We use the National Weather Service hourly forecast for each court's next open time. Under 12 mph of wind, under a 30% chance of rain and above 40°F is playable.
Not while we're in beta. Joining the waitlist is free too.

Courts with lights are open 7 am to 10 pm. Courts without lights close at 7 pm. All times are local to the court. When a court closes for a day for repairs, the court finder says so.
